messages.subject: UT Austin Student Interested in Summer 2025 Internship Porgram
messages.body:
Hello AGC Recruiting Team,

I hope this email finds you well. I am reaching out to express my interest in your Summer 2025 Internship Program. I am a Sophomore studying Economics and Business at the University of Texas, Austin. I am particularly interested in a boutique, tech-focused firm, which makes AGC especially exciting. Attached below is my resume and a copy of my transcript. Please let me know if you have any further questions, and I look forward to the recruitment process!

Best,
Jonathan Nachman
messages.note: Sent to a shared inbox (internships@), not a person. Never answered. Subject line contains a typo, 'Porgram'.
